name: Blocker ON = ALL Blocked - Z Simple Blocker
description: Blocks ALL new pages, tabs and windows content AND closes them when activated. Also blocks clicked URL links. Turn ON and OFF whenever you want! [Tip: Add it to your toolbar!] For example, it's the perfect solution when you're watching an online video and don't want ANY popups or new pages or tabs to open when you click on the video! ;) You're welcome! Enjoy it! - Created by SzikraZ
